photo.failedToOpen: Failed to open photo. Please try again
photo.overflow: Added {{added}} of {{picked}}: the grid has {{max}} cells.

notes.label: Result
notes.cancelled: Recognition cancelled. The photo is kept — tap “Retry” to recognize it again.
notes.checkBeforeSend: Check the data before sending — recognition can make mistakes.

resetDialog.title: Reset workspace?
resetDialog.message: Photo and recognized text will be removed.

removeDialog.title: Remove this tag?
removeDialog.message: The photo and recognized text of this tag will be deleted. The other tags stay.

replaceDialog.title: Replace photo?
replaceDialog.message: The current photo and recognized data will be removed.

uploadDialog.unconfiguredMessage: The tag is saved in the upload queue and will be written to the table once storage is set up in Settings → Storage.
uploadDialog.tableMissingMessage: The tag is saved in the queue, but there is nowhere to write it: there is no table at the location from the settings. Point to an existing log in Settings → Storage.

qualityDialog.title: Poor photo quality
qualityDialog.message: Retaking the photo is recommended: {{issues}}. Check the recognized values.
qualityDialog.messageGeneric: Some values are uncertain. Retaking the photo is recommended; check the recognized values.

photoIssues.cropped: the tag is not fully in the frame
photoIssues.far: the tag is too far away

formDialog.title: Form not selected
formDialog.message: Before sending, choose what the tag is for: bar or coil — tap the “Form” field at the top of the card.

sendDialog.noneMessage: Select tags to send in the grid — the mark in the bottom left corner of a photo.
sendDialog.recognizingMessage: It is still being recognized — wait a few seconds.
sendDialog.failedMessage: It could not be recognized — tap “Retry” or deselect it in the grid.
sendDialog.partialMessage: {{ready}} of {{total}} are ready to send. The others ({{rest}}) are still recognizing, failed or have no form — they stay on the screen.

grid.locked: Cell {{number}}: fill the previous ones first
